title: PhD Research Fellow position in Mathematics
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in Mathematics, available at the Department of Mathematics, as part of QSTAR – Centre for quantum computing and applications.

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than 01.04.2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year may be considered, and it will involve 25 % of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualifications of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is Department of Mathematics/QSTAR at Blindern, Oslo.

Job description

The position is affiliated with QSTAR - Centre for Quantum Computing and Applications. QSTAR is a five-year research centre funded by the Research Council of Norway (project number 361617) and hosted and led by SINTEF. It brings together researchers at SINTEF, UiO, NTNU, OsloMet and Simula Research Laboratory, with international partners at the University of Copenhagen and RISE in Sweden.

The centre connects four research work packages: fault tolerance and error correction; compilation and Hamiltonian engineering; foundations of quantum algorithms; and quantum algorithms for applications. Together, they address how quantum information can be protected, how algorithms can be implemented, and where quantum computation may offer advantages, particularly in chemistry and optimisation.

PhD candidates become part of a research community spanning mathematics, physics, chemistry and optimisation. The centre’s programme includes seminars, PhD schools, annual retreats and conferences, alongside opportunities for international exchange and collaboration across partner institutions.

Learn more about the centre’s research, people and activities on the QSTAR website

The position is advertised within work package 1 “Fault-tolerance and error correction”. More specifically, the successful candidate will work on theoretical questions in one of the following two projects.

The first project studies questions in the fields of quantum groups and tensor categories, with a particular focus on possible applications to fault-tolerant quantum computation through the paradigm of topological quantum computation. We also aim to develop and extend connections between these fields and quantum information science in a broad sense, beyond fault-tolerance.

The second project is concerned with employing methods of group theory, representation theory and operator algebras to construct new families of quantum codes with improved performance and novel features. Another core task in the second project will be to study various families of quantum channels from the perspective of quantifying noise.

The PhD Fellow will join the Operator Algebra group in Section 6 at the Department of Mathematics, where the work will be conducted in close collaboration with other members of the QSTAR project.

The PhD Fellow will:

  • Look for application of the theory of tensor category and quantum groups to problems related to topological quantum computation.
  • Look for connections between quantum information theory and noncommutative geometry through studying quantum channels as noise models.
  • Work in close collaboration with researchers in operator algebras and quantum information theory.
  • Join a research group with broad expertise in mathematics, quantum chemistry, and theoretical physics.
What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in Mathematics or Physics. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Relevant experience in operator algebras, representation theory, or quantum information theory
  • For applicants with an MSc in Physics, a solid mathematical component in their education is required.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Candidates without a master’s degree have until 31.03.2027 to complete the final exam.

Desired qualifications:

  • Documented, sound knowledge of one or more of the following topics: C*-algebras, noncommutative geometry, representation theory and its applications to quantum groups, quantum field theory, quantum information theory
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in a Scandinavian language

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 
We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. We hope you will apply for the position with us.

How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest) of maximum length 2 A4 pages.
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copies of the original Bachelor and Master’s degree diploma and transcripts of records
  • Letters of recommendation: these are not to be submitted with the application, but may be requested later during the evaluation process
  • Documentation of English Language requirements. The appointed candidate cannot start in the position until approved documentation of English language proficiency has been submitted.
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Mathematics is part of the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences at the University of Oslo. The Department is engaged in teaching and research covering a wide spectrum of subjects within mathematics, mechanics and statistics. The research is on theory, methods and applications. The areas represented include: fluid mechanics, biomechanics, statistics and data science, computational mathematics, combinatorics, partial differential equations, stochastics and risk, algebra, geometry, topology, operator algebras, complex analysis and logic. We have almost 50 persons in permanent academic positions and a large number of post docs and Ph.D. students. We also have an administrative and technical staff. The department represents a leading research environment in mathematical areas in Norway, and has a highly international profile.

title: PhD Candidates in advanced arc and friction stir welding processes for recycled aluminium
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The position is a 3-year doctoral research fellowship starting in 2027. The PhD candidate will be embedded in the welding and joining research activities of SFI FAST and will work closely with NTNU, SINTEF, and leading international industrial partners in the aluminium value chain.

The PhD position focuses on understanding the influence of impurities coming from recycled Aluminium on the weldability of different alloys. These impurities can alter the weldability, microstructure, and performance of Aluminium welds compared to the reference alloy. Solidification and liquation cracking, pore formation, heat-affected zone softening, and degradation of corrosion resistance are some examples of possible challenges. However, the knowledge is limited about any of these possible changes. Therefore, the candidate needs to provide a thorough investigation of the welding process using conventional techniques and develop new methodologies. In addition, the welding procedure adoption to enhance the performance of the alloys based on their metallurgical characteristics shall be developed. Therefore, the candidate should have a great understanding of the welding process-microstructure-performance. 

 Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department. You will be supervised by Professor Vahid Hosseini.

About the project

SFI FAST (Future Aluminium Structures) is a national Centre for Research-based Innovation (SFI) funded by the Research Council of Norway and the aluminum industry. The Centre is led by NTNU in close collaboration with SINTEF and a broad consortium of 15 leading industrial partners across the aluminium value chain. FAST runs from 2026 to 2034 and represents one of Norway’s most ambitious long-term research initiatives within aluminium materials, manufacturing technologies, and circular economy.

The primary objective of FAST is to establish the scientific and technological knowledge base required to enable the large-scale use of post-consumer scrap (PCS) aluminium in high-value, structural, and safety-critical products. FAST adopts a through-scale and through-process research methodology, integrating materials science, manufacturing processes, product and structural design, and lifecycle performance.

A key outcome of FAST is the development of the FAST Virtual Lab, a digital framework combining experimental data, physics-based models, and data-driven methods to support design, manufacturing, and decision-making across aluminium value chains.

Education and competence building are central pillars of FAST. The Centre will educate more than 18 PhD and postdoctoral researchers and over 100 MSc students, strengthening Norway’s international position in aluminium research and innovation. The two positions posted here will be among the first ones to start in the Centre.

Please see the centre’s website: Future Aluminium Structures (FAST) - NTNU

Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Take part in the mandatory PhD research education programme
  • Develop arc welding (GTAW and GMAW) and Friction stir welding for alloys with different impurity levels to minimize welding defects and improve mechanical and corrosion performance
  • Develop knowledge in the influence of impurities on the weld’s physics, defects, microstructure, and performance
  • Thermodynamic modelling of solidification and precipitation behaviour of recycled aluminium
  • Development of weldability tests to quantify welding performance of Aluminium Alloys 
  • Advanced characterization of welded samples using Laser Confocal Microscopy, In-situ mechanical testing, SEM, FIB, and EBSD.
  • Conduct and publish high-level research in peer-reviewed journals and international conferences
  • Work closely with industrial and academic partners and participate in relevant SFI FAST activities, including mentoring and supervising MSc students

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Mechanical engineering, Materials Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • You must have an academically relevant background within fusion and solid-state welding, welding metallurgy, and material characterization
  • Documented strong background in:
    • Experimental welding research
    • Material characterization and testing
  • Excellent written presentation skills and oral English language skills

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Basic knowledge of robotic welding
  • Knowledge of weld monitoring systems with focus on arc characteristics and thermal cycle analysis
  • Knowledge of thermomechanical modelling of welding process
  • Scandinavian language skills
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Highly motivated
  • Able to work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyse data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • Keen interest in learning and working in teams

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer
  • Exciting and stimulating tasks in a strong international academic environment
  • SFI FAST facilities, industrial network, and a joint PhD environment 
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page). The motivation letter must be aligned with the subject of this call and why the candidate finds themselves suitable for this position.
  • Possibly publications or other relevant research work (the candidate’s contribution to each work must be clarified (performed tasks and percentage of contribution)) 
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees, their relation to the applicant, and their recommendation letters for your application for this position (Note: the referees will also be directly contacted for shortlisted candidates for the position) 
  • documentation of the required criteria

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Vahid Hosseini, e-mail: vahid.hosseini@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Senior Consultant Hedda Winnberg, e-mail: hedda.winnberg@ntnu.no

title: Experienced in salmon filleting or food production? We want to hear from you!
description:
Logent is looking for skilled seafood production workers for assignments in the Oslo region. We are particularly interested in candidates with hands-on experience from fish processing plants, salmon filleting and industrial seafood production.

Are you currently working in the seafood industry in Western Norway or Northern Norway and interested in a new opportunity? We offer assignments in the Oslo region, with the possibility of longer-term work for candidates willing to relocate. No higher Norwegian language skills required – English is sufficient.

We Are Looking For Candidates With Experience In
  • Industrial salmon filleting and trimming
  • Fish processing and seafood production
  • Preparing and handling fresh fish on production lines
  • Packing, sorting and quality control in seafood processing facilities
  • Working with industrial seafood production equipment

Relevant experience from a fish processing plant or seafood factory is essential. We are primarily looking for candidates who know the production environment and can contribute from day one.

Experience from restaurants og hotel environments does not meet the requirements for these positions.

Your Responsibilities
  • Depending on your experience and department, your tasks may include:
  • Filleting and trimming salmon and other seafood
  • Processing and handling fish on industrial production lines
  • Packing, sorting and inspecting finished products
  • Maintaining high standards of quality, hygiene and food safety
  • Following HACCP procedures and production routines
  • Keeping workstations and production areas clean and organised
  • Internal logistics, packing and palleting salmon
What We Offer
  • Competitive salary and working conditions
  • Flexible start up, this year og early next year. 
  • Modern seafood production facilities
  • Training and onboarding
  • Possibility of extended or long-term assignments for candidates relocating to the Oslo region who fits most criterias.
  • An international working environment
  • Free parking
  • Working hours: 06:00–14:00 or 11:00–19:00.
Who Should Apply?

You should:

  • Have at least 6–12 months of relevant experience from industrial seafood production, preferably salmon filleting, altnerativley poultry or meat.
  • Be comfortable working with fresh fish in a chilled production environment
  • Be able to work efficiently while maintaining high quality and hygiene standards
  • Be willing to work in the Oslo region
  • Speak English; Norwegian language at high level is not required, but an advantage with basic norwegian. 
  • If you have experience with electric pallet truck, it is a plus, and T1 certificate. 

Candidates currently living in Western Norway or Northern Norway are encouraged to apply, especially if they have experience from established seafood processing plants.

Recruitment Process

We review applications continuously and contact relevant candidates for interviews at our office or per Teams 

Please upload your CV and clearly describe your experience with salmon filleting, trimming or industrial seafood processing.

title: Tjen penger mens du har det gøy! Vi søker selgere til Talkmore i Vestfold og Telemark
description:
Vi søker selgere til Talkmore i Vestfold og Telemark! Vil du ha en jobb der du møter nye mennesker, har det gøy på jobb og kan påvirke din egen lønn?

Da kan dette være noe for deg!

Bundl AS søker nå flere sultne og motiverte selgere til vårt nye salgsteam for Talkmore i Vestfold og Telemark.

Her blir ikke arbeidsdagen tilbrakt bak et skrivebord. Du jobber på stand på kjøpesentre, messer, torg og andre steder der folk ferdes. Du møter nye mennesker hver dag, slår av en prat og hjelper dem med å finne gode løsninger på mobilabonnement.

Og det beste? Gode resultater skal merkes på lønnsslippen.

Hos oss får du gode provisjons- og bonusordninger, og leverer du bra, har du svært gode muligheter til å tjene godt.

Samtidig blir du en del av et sosialt og engasjert salgsteam som jobber sammen, konkurrerer, motiverer hverandre og har det gøy på jobb.

Vi kommer til å jobbe på forskjellige steder rundt i Vestfold og Telemark, så du får en variert arbeidshverdag med nye mennesker, nye steder og nye muligheter.

Hva går jobben ut på?

Som selger representerer du Talkmore på stand rundt omkring i Vestfold og Telemark.

Du vil blant annet:

  • Møte nye mennesker og skape god kontakt

  • Ta initiativ til samtaler med kunder som går forbi standen

  • Finne ut hva kunden trenger og presentere gode mobilabonnement fra Talkmore

  • Jobbe mot egne mål og konkurrere om bonuser

  • Skape gode kundeopplevelser

  • Reise rundt til forskjellige kjøpesentre, messer, torg og andre salgsplasser i regionen

  • Bidra med energi, godt humør og resultater i teamet

Du kommer til å få ja, du kommer til å få nei, og du kommer definitivt til å bli bedre på å kommunisere, selge og håndtere mennesker underveis.

Dette får du hos oss

Vi mener at det skal lønne seg å være god.

Derfor får du:

  • Gode provisjons- og bonusordninger

  • Mulighet for svært god inntekt basert på egne resultater

  • Firmabil til transport mellom salgssteder i arbeidstiden

  • Nødvendig salgsutstyr og ID-kort

  • En variert arbeidsdag på forskjellige steder i Vestfold og Telemark

  • Strukturert opplæring gjennom vår egen salgsskole

  • Grundig opplæring i salg og Talkmores produkter

  • Tett oppfølging fra erfarne salgsledere

  • Konkurranser, bonuser og premier

  • Sosiale aktiviteter og et lag som liker å ha det gøy sammen

  • Reelle karrieremuligheter innen salg, opplæring og ledelse

Hvem tror vi vil trives her?

Vi tror du vil passe godt inn dersom du:

  • Er over 18 år

  • Liker å prate med og bli kjent med nye mennesker

  • Er utadvendt og tør å ta kontakt med folk

  • Klarer å høre et nei uten at dagen er ødelagt

  • Har konkurranseinstinkt og liker å jakte resultater

  • Motiveres av muligheten til å tjene godt

  • Trives med høyt tempo og varierte dager

  • Er pålitelig og møter opp med riktig innstilling

  • Liker å jobbe i team og bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø

  • Har lyst til å utvikle deg, både faglig og personlig

Har du salgserfaring fra før, er det selvfølgelig et pluss. Har du ikke det, lærer vi deg!

Mer enn bare en salgsjobb

Hos Bundl AS skal du kunne komme inn uten lang erfaring og bygge deg opp gjennom resultater.

Vi investerer i opplæring og tett oppfølging, og de som viser at de vil noe, får muligheten til å ta mer ansvar.

For de rette personene finnes det muligheter til å utvikle seg videre som teamleder, salgsleder eller innen opplæring.

Vi ønsker å bygge et skikkelig bra salgsteam i Vestfold og Telemark, med folk som trives sammen, heier på hverandre og har lyst til å lykkes.

Her handler det ikke bare om å selge mest mulig, men også om å skape et miljø der folk gleder seg til å komme på jobb.

Så hvis du vil ha en jobb der du kan tjene godt, møte masse mennesker, utvikle deg og ha det gøy sammen med andre, vil vi gjerne høre fra deg!

Klar for å bli med på laget?

Vi intervjuer aktuelle kandidater fortløpende, så send inn søknaden din og fortell oss litt om deg selv!

Du trenger ikke å ha den lengste CV-en. Vi er mest interessert i hvem du er og hva som motiverer deg.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bundl AS er et selskap i vekst som jobber med møtebooking, salg, rekruttering og outsourcing av salgsprosjekter for bedrifter over hele Norge. Siden oppstarten i 2024 har vi hatt fokus på å bygge sterke salgsmiljøer, levere gode resultater for våre samarbeidspartnere og skape utviklingsmuligheter for våre ansatte.

Ledelsen i Bundl AS har samlet over 100 års erfaring innen salg, markedsføring og møtebooking. Denne erfaringen bruker vi aktivt for å utvikle både selskapet og menneskene som jobber hos oss.

Vi mener at våre ansatte er vår viktigste ressurs. Derfor investerer vi tungt i opplæring, kompetanseutvikling og tett oppfølging, slik at alle hos oss får verktøyene, kunnskapen og støtten de trenger for å lykkes.

Hos Bundl AS får du muligheten til å utvikle deg i et ambisiøst og resultatorientert miljø med høyt tempo, sterke karrieremuligheter og fokus på personlig vekst.

title: Led ditt eget salgsteam og tjen godt! Vi søker nå teamleder til Talkmore
description:
Er du god på salg, liker å ta ansvar og motiveres av å få andre til å lykkes?

Da kan dette være jobben for deg!

Bundl AS søker nå en engasjert og resultatorientert teamleder til vårt nye salgsteam for Talkmore i Vestfold og Telemark.

Her får du muligheten til å lede et team med 4 selgere som skal jobbe med standsalg på kjøpesentre, messer, torg og andre steder der folk ferdes.

Dette er ikke en jobb der du sitter på et kontor og forteller andre hva de skal gjøre. Du er ute sammen med teamet ditt, møter kunder, selger, motiverer og viser vei gjennom egne resultater.

Vi ser etter deg som liker å vinne, men som også synes det er minst like gøy å se andre lykkes.

Og det beste? Gode resultater skal merkes på lønnsslippen.

Hos oss får du gode inntjeningsmuligheter, samtidig som du får ansvar, ledererfaring og muligheten til å være med på å bygge opp et nytt salgsteam.

Hva går jobben ut på?

Som teamleder får du ansvaret for den daglige driften av salgsteamet vårt for Talkmore i Vestfold og Telemark.

Du vil blant annet:

  • Lede, motivere og følge opp et team med 4 selgere

  • Jobbe aktivt med salg sammen med teamet

  • Sørge for god stemning, høyt engasjement og gode resultater

  • Følge opp individuelle mål og teamets samlede resultater

  • Hjelpe selgerne med å utvikle seg og bli tryggere i salgsrollen

  • Planlegge og koordinere arbeidsdagene på ulike salgssteder

  • Sørge for at teamet møter forberedt og representerer Talkmore på en god måte

  • Bidra til opplæring og utvikling av både nye og eksisterende selgere

  • Skape et miljø der folk trives, konkurrerer og heier på hverandre

Du vil også være en aktiv selger selv. Vi tror nemlig at en god teamleder skal kunne vise hvordan ting gjøres, ikke bare fortelle det.

Dette får du hos oss

Vi mener at det skal lønne seg å være god, spesielt når du også bidrar til at andre lykkes.

Derfor får du:

  • Gode lønnsbetingelser med mulighet for bonus basert på resultater

  • Ansvar for ditt eget salgsteam

  • Firmabil til bruk i arbeidstiden

  • Nødvendig salgsutstyr og ID-kort

  • En variert arbeidsdag rundt i Vestfold og Telemark

  • Grundig opplæring i Talkmores produkter og salgsmetoder

  • Opplæring og støtte innen ledelse og teamutvikling

  • Tett oppfølging og støtte fra erfarne ledere

  • Konkurranser, bonuser og premier

  • Sosiale aktiviteter og et arbeidsmiljø med mye energi

  • Muligheter for videre utvikling innen salg og ledelse

Du får frihet til å ta ansvar og sette ditt eget preg på teamet, samtidig som du har støtte og folk rundt deg som ønsker at du skal lykkes.

Hvem tror vi vil trives her?

Vi ser etter en person som er trygg på seg selv, liker mennesker og har lyst til å skape resultater sammen med andre.

Vi tror du vil passe godt inn dersom du:

  • Er over 18 år

  • Har erfaring med salg og kan vise til gode resultater

  • Liker å ta ansvar og få andre til å prestere

  • Er flink til å motivere, kommunisere og bygge relasjoner

  • Har konkurranseinstinkt og motiveres av gode resultater

  • Er strukturert og klarer å holde oversikt i en hektisk hverdag

  • Tør å ta beslutninger og gå foran som et godt eksempel

  • Har godt humør og bidrar til et positivt arbeidsmiljø

  • Trives med å jobbe ute blant mennesker

  • Er pålitelig og tar ansvar for både egne og teamets resultater

  • Har førerkort klasse B

Har du erfaring som teamleder eller salgsleder fra før, er det selvfølgelig et stort pluss.

Men du trenger ikke nødvendigvis å ha hatt en lederstilling tidligere. Har du solid salgserfaring, gode resultater og de riktige egenskapene, vil vi gjerne høre fra deg!

Mer enn bare en teamlederjobb

Hos Bundl AS ønsker vi å bygge et salgsteam der folk både presterer og trives.

Som teamleder blir du en viktig del av dette. Du får være med på å bygge opp teamet, utvikle selgerne og skape en kultur der folk motiverer hverandre til å bli bedre.

Vi ser etter en leder som ikke er redd for å brette opp ermene, ta i et tak og være en del av gjengen.

Du skal være den som får opp energien når dagen går litt tregt, hjelper en selger som står fast og sørger for at teamet jobber sammen mot felles mål.

Dette er en mulighet for deg som ønsker mer ansvar, liker salg og har lyst til å utvikle deg videre som leder.

Klar for å ta ansvar for ditt eget salgsteam?

Vi intervjuer aktuelle kandidater fortløpende, så send inn søknaden din og fortell oss litt om deg selv, din salgserfaring og hvorfor du tror du vil passe som teamleder hos oss.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bundl AS er et selskap i vekst som jobber med møtebooking, salg, rekruttering og outsourcing av salgsprosjekter for bedrifter over hele Norge. Siden oppstarten i 2024 har vi hatt fokus på å bygge sterke salgsmiljøer, levere gode resultater for våre samarbeidspartnere og skape utviklingsmuligheter for våre ansatte.

Ledelsen i Bundl AS har samlet over 100 års erfaring innen salg, markedsføring og møtebooking. Denne erfaringen bruker vi aktivt for å utvikle både selskapet og menneskene som jobber hos oss.

Vi mener at våre ansatte er vår viktigste ressurs. Derfor investerer vi tungt i opplæring, kompetanseutvikling og tett oppfølging, slik at alle hos oss får verktøyene, kunnskapen og støtten de trenger for å lykkes.

Hos Bundl AS får du muligheten til å utvikle deg i et ambisiøst og resultatorientert miljø med høyt tempo, sterke karrieremuligheter og fokus på personlig vekst.

title: AI & Software Engineers
description:
Who you are

We’re looking for AI and Software Engineers to join our product team. We’re 12 engineers, a few designers and a couple of product managers, working as one unit across initiatives that support our product strategy. Together, we figure out where each of us can make the biggest impact, and that shifts as our initiatives change.

Everyone on the team builds and ships features. You take ownership, get things done and learn new tools quickly. You care about the product and the people who use it. You’re comfortable joining customer and prospect meetings, and you use what you learn to solve their needs.

 

We’re hiring for three roles:

 

Software Engineer

You might be fresh out of university, a few years into your career or looking for a place where you can take on more than your job description allows. You’re curious and keen to learn, including the procurement domain we work in.

You likely have:

  • A degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Experience building software through studies, side projects, internships or work.

  • Hands-on experience building with AI tools.

  • Bonus points for experience from a startup, student organization or project where your role was broader than the title.

 

Senior Software Engineer, Platform & Security

You bring experience in cloud infrastructure and security, and you’re someone others turn to for input on infrastructure, security and authorization. When you look at a cloud setup, you quickly see how it can improve, and you know how to fix it. Our engineers do a lot of infrastructure work themselves, so you help out, educate and spread the good word on how to make our systems more secure, reliable and well designed.

You likely have:

  • 4+ years of experience building and operating SaaS products.

  • Hands-on experience with a major cloud provider. We use Google Cloud.

  • A good understanding of how services depend on each other, and how to make them reliable, fast and cost-efficient.

  • A track record of improving the infrastructure you work on.

  • Bonus points for strong knowledge of security, authentication and authorization in distributed systems.

 

Applied AI Engineer

You have a keen interest and experience working with AI features. You understand how models work, how to get the most out of them and how to tell when the output is good enough for customers.

Companies have processed more than €500B in spend with Ignite, and we’re turning that into the strongest procurement data foundation in the Nordics. You help us get the most out of that data. You know how to set up benchmarks, you understand the evidence we need behind them and you can explain to a customer what a number means and why we calculated it that way.

You’re eager about AI, and you stay eager. What works today may be outdated in a few months, so you keep learning as new models and capabilities come out.

You likely have:

  • Experience building and shipping SaaS products.

  • Hands-on experience building features with LLMs, such as prompting, retrieval, agents and evaluation.

  • A solid grounding in statistics or quantitative methods.

  • Bonus points for experience working with large datasets and SQL.

 

For all roles

You likely have:

  • A product mindset: you care about why we build something as much as how.

  • Clear communication skills.

  • Bonus points for experience with procurement or enterprise ERP systems.

If you don’t match every point, apply anyway. Leave it to us to see where you fit.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Build and ship features across the product as part of our empowered product team.

  • Own problems from idea to production.

  • Work closely with our commercial team in customer and prospect conversations.

 

Depending on your role, you’ll also:

  • Software Engineer: Learn and grow through feedback and pairing with experienced engineers.

  • Senior Software Engineer, Platform & Security: Make our infrastructure faster, cheaper and more secure, and raise the bar for how we build and operate.

  • Applied AI Engineer: Turn our data foundation into new functionality: benchmarks, more granular insights and features customers can act on. Make our AI features better as new models come out, and make sure we can explain the results to customers.

 

Our stack

  • Frontend: React

  • Backend: Golang and TypeScript, GraphQL federation and gRPC

  • Infrastructure: Serverless on Google Cloud Run and Cloud Functions, Temporal for workflow orchestration

  • Storage and data: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, BigQuery and event-driven pipelines

  • AI tooling: Whatever works best. Right now, that’s mostly Claude Code

 

Who we are

Ignite is the leading procurement and supplier intelligence platform in the Nordics. Since 2017, we’ve helped procurement teams get full control of their spend, suppliers, contracts and risk, and act on it. Our customers have documented around €60 million in savings this year.

We’re a team of 40+ curious and collaborative builders in Oslo and Stockholm, united by a shared mission: to create an impactful platform that helps companies get the most out of their spend with the right suppliers.

We care deeply about our customers, and we believe that by working together, we can turn big ideas into reality.

 

What we offer

  • 🚀 Real ownership: you ship meaningful work and help shape both what and how we build.

  • 💸 Competitive salary and bonus program

  • 📈 Opportunity to buy shares and take part in our journey

  • 🧠 Learning budget for personal growth and development

  • 💪 Health insurance and subsidized gym membership

  • 📍 Office-first in Kvadraturen, central Oslo, with flexibility for focus days or when life needs you at home

  • 👯 Regular social events

 

Ready to make an impact?

Join us at Ignite and be part of something bigger. Apply by November 15 and let us know which role you’re applying for. We review applications as they come in, so don’t wait.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ignite is the leading procurement & supplier intelligence platform, built to give companies complete visibility and control over their spend and suppliers. Procurement data is often scattered and siloed. We bring it all together, and then go further. Ignite doesn’t just centralize your data. We connect and enrich it, transforming raw information into actionable intelligence. So your team can focus on what matters, move faster, and act confidently. With Ignite, companies get a single, intuitive platform to analyze spend, manage suppliers, gather key supplier information, monitor contracts, assess and mitigate risks, calculate emissions, and uncover savings — without jumping between spreadsheets or disconnected tools. We’re a customer-obsessed team on a mission to help procurement do their best work. Trusted by forward-thinking companies like Veidekke, OBOS, Stena Metall, Strawberry, Jordanes, and hundreds more.

title: Account Executive
description:
Mercell is the leading SaaS platform for public procurement in Europe.

At Mercell, we're on a mission to revolutionize public procurement, making it accessible and effortless for everyone involved. Imagine a world where public buyers and visionary suppliers come together seamlessly to make a great deal easier and shape the future. That's what we're all about.

With a dynamic culture built on continuous growth, trust, and collaboration, Mercell offers an environment where your talents can thrive. You will be part of an international environment with ambitious and dedicated colleagues who are passionate about what they do and supported to be themselves.

Together, let's shape the future and create real value for society, one innovative solution at a time.

Your Mission

We are looking for an ambitious Account Executive to join our Buy side sales team in Germany.

Our Account Executives are at the heart of Mercell’s mission. You’ll be a trusted advisor to public sector customers with a go-to-market approach guiding them through a value based buying journey and showing how Mercell’s solutions can help them achieve efficiency, compliance, and real impact for society. You’ll manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and qualifying leads (both inbound and outbound) to running demos, managing tender responses, negotiating terms, and closing deals. With each success, you’ll help strengthen Mercell’s presence in your market and expand our growing community of public sector partners.

Core Responsibilities

  • Proactively identify, engage, and build relationships with key decision-makers across your market.

  • Translate the business pains of the organization into a value based selling approach to drive large strategic engagements.

  • Own the entire sales journey from first contact and discovery to negotiation, closing, onboarding, and upselling.

  • Confidently demonstrate the value and impact of Mercell’s SaaS platform to organisations of all sizes.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM data in HubSpot, using insights to optimise pipeline and sales performance.

  • Stay ahead of developments in the local and European public procurement landscape to uncover new growth opportunities.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience (ideally 3-5 years) managing a full B2B SaaS sales cycle, preferably to the public sector or highly regulated industries with a tender driven sales motion.

  • Strong experience in outbound sales and pipeline generation with demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

  • Ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders and decision-makers, building trust and credibility.

  • Explaining the value of technical or SaaS solutions to a wide range of audiences.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.

  • Fluency in written and spoken German.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with public procurement, tendering, or compliance-driven buying processes.

  • Experience working in an international or multi-market sales environment.

  • Strong consultative selling mindset with a focus on long-term customer value.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile, and collaborative environment where priorities evolve.

Start date: As soon as possible

Duration: Full time Workplace type: Remote

Location: Berlin, Germany

Application Deadline: 11 October 2026. However, do not wait to submit your application - we will read applications and talk to potential candidates as we receive them

What we offer

As a fast growing technology company, we are committed to taking care of our employees through initiatives such as hybrid work to support work-life balance, health and insurance plans (may differ per country/office), pension plans, paid parental leave, social happenings and competitive salary packages. Please see https://career.mercell.com/pages/perks-benefits to get more insights on what to expect of perks, benefits and culture when joining Mercell.

Has this sparked your interest?

Then we can't wait to have you join our mission and looking forward to receiving your application!

-Mercell is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

-Mercell handles all personal data in line with GDPR and our Privacy Policy.

-Mercell does not provide relocation support. We are seeking candidates who are already based in, or have existing work authorization for, the country where the role is located.

-Mercell may carry out background checks on applicants to verify information that appears on CVs and other documentation. This background check is carried out by an external party and is not carried out without the consent of the applicant. Current applicants will receive further information about this.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Mercell, we’re transforming how businesses manage procurement and public tendering processes. As a leading provider of digital solutions for procurement, we help organizations across Europe streamline, automate, and optimize their sourcing operations. Our cloud-based platform connects buyers and suppliers, driving transparency, efficiency, and compliance in public and private sector procurement. The Problem We Solve: Procurement is often plagued by inefficiencies, manual workflows, and a lack of transparency, making it time-consuming and prone to errors. This not only impacts operational performance but can also prevent businesses from making strategic, cost-effective decisions. At Mercell, we are solving these challenges by providing an integrated solution that simplifies the tendering process, ensures compliance with regulatory standards, and empowers businesses with data-driven insights. Why We Do It: We believe that efficient procurement is at the heart of sustainable business growth. By digitizing and optimizing the procurement process, we help organizations save time, reduce costs, and make smarter decisions, all while fostering a more competitive and transparent marketplace. Our goal is to empower organizations to focus on their core business, leaving procurement complexity to us. At Mercell, we’re driven by innovation and a passion to continuously improve the procurement landscape.

title: Site Manager – Data Centre Projects
description:
Lead the site. Build what powers the digital world.

Fortica builds and finishes data centres across Norway and the Nordics. We are looking for an experienced Site Manager to lead our work on site. You keep the project safe, on time and to the right quality, and you make sure the team works well together.

What you will do

  • Lead daily work on site and coordinate our own teams, subcontractors and suppliers

  • Plan the work so it follows the schedule, the drawings and the safety rules

  • Hold toolbox talks (short safety meetings before work starts), do site inspections and quality checks

  • Report progress to the Project Manager and work with the client to solve problems quickly

  • Keep site documents in order: permits, safety reports and progress records

  • Follow up material deliveries and site logistics

Our scope on site: ceilings, sandwich panels (insulated wall and roof panels), flashing, penetration sealing, finishing works and site services.

Who you are

  • 2+ years' experience as a site manager or in a similar leadership role in construction

  • Experience from data centres, industrial buildings or other technical projects is a strong plus

  • You know how to lead subcontractors and site teams

  • You know construction safety (HSE) and quality control

  • Good English, spoken and written

  • Driving licence class B

  • Flexible and mobile: willing to travel and work on projects in Norway and abroad

  • A technical or engineering education is a plus. A data centre certification (for example CDCP) is a bonus.

What makes you a good fit

You are calm under pressure and make clear decisions. You communicate in a clear and respectful way, and you solve conflicts before they grow. Safety and quality always come first for you.

What we offer

  • 3:1 rotation (3 weeks on, 1 week off) with flights, accommodation and meals covered

  • We help you get your HMS card (the Norwegian ID card for everyone working on a construction site) if you do not have one

  • Real responsibility on large, modern projects

  • A safe workplace with fair terms and a written employment contract

  • Part of CTS Group, a large international construction group

You report to: Project ManagerLocations: Narvik, Kristiansand and Fyresdal, Norway

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We believe that through the right systems, talent and tools, it is possible to build better products, more quickly, at a lower cost.

We build with purpose – combining innovation, sustainability and openness to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions, while empowering people to think boldly, act responsibly and grow together.

title: UAS Pilot
description:
We are looking for a qualified military veteran with verified combat and instructional experience in Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) and/or Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGVs) to join us in Oslo as a UAS Pilot.

If you hold internationally recognised UAV operator certifications, have completed professional instructor training with a certified training provider, and are capable of delivering personnel training in accordance with NATO and EU requirements and modern military standards, don't hesitate to reach out to me.

In this role, you will:

  • Conduct classroom instruction, simulator sessions, and supervised flight training covering UAS operation, mission planning, system capabilities, and emergency procedures, with UGV instruction where qualified.

  • Prepare lesson plans, training materials, and practical exercises aligned with the centre’s approved syllabus, applicable EU and national aviation requirements, and relevant NATO and military training standards.

  • Prepare training missions, perform risk assessments and pre-flight checks, confirm airspace and operating permissions, and supervise activities in accordance with established safety procedures.

  • Evaluate theoretical knowledge and practical performance, provide structured feedback and remedial instruction, and maintain accurate attendance, assessment, and qualification records.

  • Conduct serviceability checks, identify and report defects, coordinate maintenance with technical personnel, and ensure training aircraft, ground-control systems, simulators, and associated equipment are ready for use.

  • Work with instructors, technical staff, and international partners to deliver consistent training; contribute to exercises and post-training reviews; and support emergency preparedness and first-aid response within the scope of certification.

You have:

  • Military service experience in UAV units, reconnaissance, artillery, Special Operations Forces (SOF), robotic systems, or related fields.

  • At least 5 years of hands-on experience operating UAVs and/or UGVs.

  • Proven experience as an instructor, trainer, or operator training lead.

  • Valid UAV operator certificates recognised in the European Union (EASA Open Category A1/A3 and A2, Specific Category, or equivalent national certifications).

  • English proficiency at C1 level or above.

  • Knowledge of risk management procedures, flight safety, mission planning, and operations in an international environment.

  • First aid certification at FPOS Level 3, FREC 3, or an equivalent international standard (TCCC, TECC, Combat Lifesaver).

  • Completion of an instructor training course delivered by a Recognised Training Provider / Awarding Organisation or another officially recognised training provider.

  • Ability to deliver theoretical and practical training sessions, assess trainees, and prepare training documentation.

What We Offer

  • An opportunity to join a growing technology company at an exciting stage of development

  • Meaningful responsibility and direct impact on products and processes

  • A collaborative and international working environment

  • Professional development and career growth opportunities

  • Competitive compensation and benefits package

title: Want to shape how a global platform with 4 million users builds with AI? Spond is hiring Software Engineer - AI Agent Platform (apply without a CV or cover letter)
description:
Want to shape how a global platform with over 4 million monthly active users builds with AI? We are looking for someone to help us build and scale our AI agent platform.

Spond is a product-driven tech company that simplifies life for sports teams, clubs, and volunteers. By streamlining administration, payments and communication, our platform takes the heavy lifting out of grassroots sports.

Today we support over 4 million monthly active users globally and are driving strong traction in markets such as the UK, France, Norway, and Germany. We consistently rank at the top of the App Store's sports category and are highly valued by our community, with a Net Promoter Score of 76, outperforming services like Netflix, Airbnb and Uber.

The position

We're looking for a Backend Software Engineer to build and maintain the platform behind our AI agents. You'll build internal products for engineers such as tooling, APIs, SDKs, integrations, and developer workflows. You'll take them from design through to production and scaling, improving developer experience and driving real adoption across Spond's engineering teams.

This role sits in our Platform Engineering & AI team, which owns Spond's infrastructure and developer platform. You don't need to be an infrastructure expert for this role. We care most about strong software engineering fundamentals and genuine motivation to build in the AI space and to work in a platform team. We collaborate closely inside the team, so you'll naturally pick up our platform stack (Kubernetes on AWS, IaC, CI/CD) and pitch in where it helps, while your main focus stays on the AI agent platform and related tooling.

What you'll be working on:

  • Building and maintaining the Go services, libraries, and tooling that let engineers across the company build with AI safely and consistently.

  • Developing agent-based tooling and workflows that drive AI adoption internally, for example cloud agents in developer workflows and automated root cause analysis.

  • Designing robust APIs and integrations between our agent platform, internal/external services, and model providers.

  • Ensuring the software you ship is observable, reliable, and well-tested, and taking it end-to-end from design to operation.

  • Contributing to the broader platform where it helps the team.

  • Collaborating with engineering teams to understand their needs, remove friction, and pave golden paths for how AI is used at Spond.

  • Advocating for good practice through clear documentation and knowledge sharing, so adoption sticks.

What can we offer?

  • A passionate and dedicated team with a high level of professional expertise.

  • The opportunity to work on a product used by millions of people.

  • Flexible working hours and the possibility to work from home.

  • Access to a company cabin for you and your family.

  • Competitive salary, professional development budget, strong insurance coverage, pension plan, and occupational health services.

  • Newly renovated offices with a cafeteria, gym, and pleasant social areas.

What we look for:

  • Backend expertise; at least 3 years of development experience is a useful reference, but we care more about how you've grown and how clearly you think than exact tenure.

  • Comfortable in at least one backend language and keen to work in Go, which we use for platform and agent tooling.

  • A solid grasp of how modern software is built and shipped: testing, code review, CI/CD, and the wider development lifecycle. This is what you'll encode into agents and tooling.

  • A strong appetite to build in the AI and agent space. Experience with AI-powered tooling or building agents is a plus, but motivation and curiosity matter most.

  • Familiarity with AI guardrails and secure, responsible use of AI is a strong plus.

  • Keen to work in a platform team and upskill on our stack: Kubernetes, AWS, and infrastructure as code

  • Owns problems end-to-end and pushes them over the line without close oversight.

  • Clear communicator who enjoys documentation, advocacy, and knowledge sharing.

  • Fluency in English is essential (understanding Norwegian is a plus but not mandatory).

Apply without CV or cover letter!

title: BPA-assistenter søkes til ung mann i Oslo – dag, kveld, helg og natt.
description:
Vil du ha en meningsfull jobb og bli en viktig del av hverdagen til en musikk- og matglad ung mann?

Vi ønsker å styrke assistentteamet rundt en sosial og aktiv ung mann som bor hjemme med familien på Løren og Nordstrand i Oslo. Nå søker vi 2–3 nye BPA-assistenter, og har særlig behov for deg som har mulighet til å jobbe både dag- og kveldsvakter i ukedagene.

Han trives med musikk, matlaging, bilturer, cafébesøk og å være ute blant folk. Han får jevnlig oppfølging som en del av sin rehabilitering, og hverdagen består av en kombinasjon av aktiviteter, hvile, avtaler og små og store opplevelser.

Som assistent blir du en del av et team rundt ham, hvor trygghet, gode relasjoner og stabilitet i hverdagen står sentralt..

Hva går jobben ut på?

Som BPA-assistent bidrar du til at han kan gjennomføre hverdagen og aktivitetene sine med den støtten han trenger. Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være:

  • Bistand i daglige rutiner og personlig stell
  • Følge til avtaler, blant annet fysioterapi, ergoterapi og annen helseoppfølging
  • Aktivitet og trening etter avtale med familien
  • Turer, bilturer, cafébesøk, kino og andre sosiale aktiviteter
  • Hjemmeaktiviteter og støtte i daglige gjøremål
  • Bistand ved forflytning

Arbeidsdagene vil variere ut fra planer, aktiviteter og behov.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Det viktigste for oss er at du er en person som bidrar til trygghet og stabilitet, og som ønsker å bli kjent med ham og hverdagen hans.

Vi tror du vil passe godt i rollen dersom du:

  • Er omsorgsfull, stabil og ansvarsbevisst
  • Møter andre med respekt og nysgjerrighet
  • Har en positiv og trygg fremtoning
  • Er tålmodig og god til å bygge relasjoner
  • Er komfortabel med en ung og direkte person som er tydelig på egne interesser og ønsker
  • Er strukturert, samtidig som du kan være fleksibel når hverdagen krever det

Det er en fordel om du kjenner deg igjen i det unge voksne miljøet i assistentteamet, som i dag hovedsakelig består av personer i alderen ca. 22–35 år, men vi vurderer selvfølgelig søkere bredt.

Førerkort klasse B er en fordel.

Arbeidstid og behov

Vi har først og fremst behov for assistenter som har god tilgjengelighet på ukedager, både på dagtid og kveldstid.

Det ledige behovet er per nå omtrent:

  • Ukedager: 3 x 8-timersvakter per uke, fordelt på både tidlig- og senvakter
  • Helg: 2–3 x 8-timersvakter per måned
  • Natt: 3–4 nattevakter per måned

Du trenger ikke nødvendigvis å kunne dekke alle typer vakter. Skriv gjerne tydelig når og hvor mye du har mulighet til å jobbe.

Vi ser for oss å ansette 2–3 nye assistenter, slik at vi får et stabilt og fleksibelt team rundt ham.

Vi tilbyr
  • En meningsfull jobb hvor du blir en viktig del av en ung manns hverdag
  • God opplæring og oppfølging
  • Et inkluderende assistentteam
  • Varierte arbeidsdager
  • Mulighet for både faste vakter og tilkallingsarbeid
  • Lønn etter tariff
Høres dette ut som noe for deg?

Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg. Fortell oss litt om deg selv, hvorfor du kunne tenke deg å jobbe som BPA og hvilke dager og tidspunkter du vanligvis har mulighet til å jobbe.

Vi vurderer kandidater fortløpende.

Før eventuell ansettelse må det fremlegges politiattest, jf. helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven § 5-4. Attesten skal ikke være eldre enn tre måneder.

Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon skal BPA bidra til muligheten til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv, med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse.

BPA handler om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker på lik linje med andre samfunnsborgere.

Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

Gutten har to yngre søsken, så det er viktig at den som blir ansatt er glad i små barn og kan tåle noe støynivå. Det er ønskelig med en assistent som har anledning til å bli over lenger tid.
